text:
anna: NimbusHealth says POC succeeded and they want to convert to PO. They returned MSA/DPA redlines and asked for Net60. Need quick decision on prepay, POC SLA language, and who can sign the order form. cc @carlos @jess @tom

carlos: Legal quick take  they removed our limited audit clause and added customer-managed HSM. For a 2-week POC we should: 1) keep HSM out, offer KMS attestation; 2) add a one-page POC addendum that limits audit to scoped attestation and sets a 30-day data deletion. I can draft it today.

jess: Finance: Net60 is high risk without credit. For short trials we require either 50% prepay or an approved PO + credit. I can approve Net45 + 50% prepay if billing contact and remit details/W-9 are provided.

tom: SE: We won't promise prod SLOs for a POC. Suggest wording: "POC performance objective (non-binding): median latency target 150ms" and attach a short perf annex. I'll run a perf test Monday and paste logs.

sec-bot: Security questionnaire received: https://redwood-secure/qs/4201 They flagged HSM requirement. POC-level response: provide KMS attestation; customer HSM not available for evaluation.

anna: Proposed offer to Nimbus: 1) one-page POC addendum (legal) 2) Payment: 50% prepay, remainder Net45 3) SLA: POC performance objective (non-binding) median <150ms 4) E-sign by authorized procurement rep + PO attachment. Any objections?

carlos: No objections. I'll remove mandatory HSM for POC and weave the perf objective into the addendum.

jess: Fine. I'll start credit checks; have them send PO/W-9 to billing@redwood.example. Approve Net45+50% prepay for POC.

tom: I'll run perf Monday and share numbers.

anna: Actions: @carlos draft addendum; @tom perf run; @jess collect remit/W-9; I'll route e-sign envelope once addendum ready. I'll tell the customer about 50% prepay and e-sign + PO path. :thumbsup:
